# Portable Wallet Profile for Portable Web Spaces (PWS-WALLET)

> The Portable Wallet Profile is a companion profile to Portable Web Spaces (PWS), the permissioned cloud storage API. It has two halves. The server requirements half states what a portable digital wallet needs from any PWS server: the PWS and companion-profile versions and feature tokens a wallet depends on, so a server can advertise that it satisfies them (by listing the profile's persistent identifier, `https://w3id.org/pws/wallet-profile`, in its service description) and a wallet can check before it trusts the server with an account. The wallet data conventions half states how a portable wallet lays out its data on that server: the Space roles an account holds, the system collections and records, and the backup bundle an account is exported, restored, and moved with. A server can satisfy the first half alone; the second binds wallet implementations, so that a wallet written in any language can read, restore, and move an account written by another.

This is an experimental draft (v0.1), undergoing regular revisions. It is authored as a single Markdown file, `spec.md`, which is the authoritative full text. The rendered HTML below is a static, pre-rendered snapshot of that same document, so it can be fetched and read without executing JavaScript.

## Docs

- [Specification, full text (Markdown source)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interop-alliance/portable-wallet-profile-spec/main/spec.md): The entire profile. Read this one if you want everything.
- [Specification, rendered](https://interop-alliance.github.io/portable-wallet-profile-spec/): The same document as static HTML, with section numbering, cross-references, and a table of contents. Requires no JavaScript.
- [Specification, full text (Markdown source, published)](https://interop-alliance.github.io/portable-wallet-profile-spec/spec.md): The Markdown source, served from the same origin as the rendered page.
- [Portable Web Spaces](https://w3c-ccg.github.io/wallet-attached-storage-spec/): The storage API this profile layers on.
- [Encrypted Collections for Portable Web Spaces](https://interop-alliance.github.io/encrypted-collections-spec/): The sibling profile a wallet's encrypted collections follow.

## Optional

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/interop-alliance/portable-wallet-profile-spec): Source, issue tracker, and revision history.
